name: malbork-castle
documented_evidence: Museum map/history distinguish High, Middle and Lower Castles. Retained OSM plan resolves High Castle core51×61m and its26×32m court, the diagonal southwest dansker bridge, Middle Castle U-plan, Grand Master Palace and eastern Karwan armoury.
modeling_qualifications: Mapped named range positions replace approximate repeated wards. The lower service ranges and separate rampart ways follow retained source traces and production grades. Bell tower64m, secondary building elevations, roof pitches and window/bay counts remain proportional estimates pending measured elevation drawings. The large open lower ward retains unmodeled source features.
attribution: Original procedural metric mesh; no downloaded mesh or photo textures. Map ring evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), via Protomaps. Operator texts/images are referenced, not redistributed.
review_status: All3LODs validated and actual-engine capture visually reviewed on frozen app ca938100f84a3acc203e177603e20398a5d4e760e7c7ef4ff915a5de59a0673c. No obvious buried base or source-building interpenetration in reviewed view. Finer architectural dimensions remain estimates where qualified above.
